description: This file contains a smoke test script for the 'Stories' API endpoints and specifically tests for the presence of a story titled 'The Focus Master' and its first episode. It verifies the list of stories and the episodes data by sending HTTP requests to the specified backend base URL, then outputs the results in JSON format.
